dedupe_keys.name: cyber security modbus ics dataset university of coimbra modbus tcp testbed captures

description: This dataset holds network packet captures from a small process automation testbed using Modbus/TCP, recorded to study machine learning for intrusion and denial-of-service detection in industrial control systems. The testbed emulates a pump driven by an electric motor through a variable frequency drive, controlled by a PLC that reads liquid temperature from a Modbus RTU (a potentiometer on an Arduino) and talks to an HMI. Ivo Frazão, Pedro Abreu, Tiago Cruz, Helder Araújo and Paulo Simões of the University of Coimbra produced it in the EU H2020 ATENA project and published it on IEEE DataPort in January 2019. Coverage is one laboratory testbed in Portugal. Format and access: PCAP files; DataPort holds about a third of the traces and needs an account, and the full set is on a public GitHub release. Licence: not stated; citation of the CRITIS 2018 paper requested. Caveats: a single small process limits realism, and attack types reflect the 2018 study. It supports testing of cyber attack detection for resilience studies of water and industrial control systems. Related catalogue records are the Zero-SWARM Modbus traffic captures and the IEC 60870-5-104 SCADA intrusion detection dataset.
